description: This file is a TypeScript script for generating content for a developer roadmap project. It reads roadmap data, processes nodes and edges, and uses AI to generate markdown content for topics and subtopics, saving the results to files.

methods.name: writeTopicContent
methods.description: Generates a markdown introduction for a given topic using AI, based on a prompt constructed with the roadmap title and topic details.

methods.name: writeNodeContent
methods.description: Reads a node's markdown file, checks if it's empty, and if so, generates new content using AI and writes it to the file.
